evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Directive sets a recurring future cadence and frames an unrehersed rollback as a hypothetical absence, speaking to a general principle rather than a specific event.
Summary line names a planned recurring activity — future-irrealis attention on a specific named rehearsal program.
Assigns a named individual as owner — present-realis attention on a concrete person.
